quest:Shuvelle1.name: Mayoral_Luck
quest:Shuvelle1.description: Kill Mamooths and get lucky with tusk drops. If you fail, you need to FORFEIT the quest in the codex.

quest:Shuvelle2.name: Mayoral_Skill
quest:Shuvelle2.description: Bring some Mosquisnow Bugs to Shuvelle.

quest:Shuvelle3.name: Mayoral_Sack_Size
quest:Shuvelle3.description: Have 8000 Mamooth tusks in your inventory at once. She won't take them from you, don't worry.

quest:Shuvelle4.name: Mayoral_Movie_Taste
quest:Shuvelle4.description: Get a DVD from mamooths, which is a super rare drop.

quest:Shuvelle5.name: Diggy_Hole!
quest:Shuvelle5.description: Kill mamooths and have shovels drop into the place right under the rope.

quest:Shuvelle6.name: Diggy_Diggy_Hole!
quest:Shuvelle6.description: Kill Snowman and have shovels drop into the place right above the Totem.

quest:Shuvelle7.name: Dig_Diggily_Diggy_Dig_Dig_Hole!
quest:Shuvelle7.description: Kill Thermisters, and have shovels drop into the place right near the, uh... hmm idk, but you'll figure it out!.

item:Timecandy1.name: 1_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy1.description: Hold down to instantly get 1 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:GemP16.name: Dungeon_Loot_Dice
item:GemP16.description: Hold down to get a loot roll! Use it anywhere you like! IMPORTANT: You need to be Dungeon Rank 10+ to get Tier 2 Keychains, and Rank 20+ to get Tier 3 keychains.

item:Bug3.name: Sentient_Cereal
item:Bug3.description: Honestly, I was shocked too at first when I learned that cereal in real life was harvested from Cereal Bugs. Seriously, look it up! Most cereal before 1960 were made from harvested Cereal Bug Nests!

item:Fish3.name: Jellyfish
item:Fish3.description: Don't let it sting you, unless you're into getting tinkled on by random beach-goers.

item:Bug5.name: Mosquisnow
item:Bug5.description: I'm so tired of all these blood sucking vermin in IdleOn... and these mosquisnow bugs are annoying too!

item:Timecandy3.name: 4_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy3.description: Hold down to instantly get 4 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:SnowB2.name: Mamooth_Tusk
item:SnowB2.description: No see, this is a mamOOth tusk, not a mammoth tusk, thats why you think it looks weird. Trust me, it's an incredibly drawn mamooth tusk, truly a work of art.

item:Quest59.name: Shuvelle's_Vote
item:Quest59.description: A slip of paper indicating that a Ms. Shuvelle La Deuge intends to vote for Mayor Hoggindaz

item:SnowB2a.name: Ice_Age_3
item:SnowB2a.description: The thrilling documentary that captures the first three years of Jonathan Ice's life, from birth to preschool. It also has thousands of 1 Star Ratings online claiming it's false advertising.

item:Timecandy2.name: 2_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy2.description: Hold down to instantly get 2 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:NPCtoken35.name: Shuvelle_Token
item:NPCtoken35.description: Proof that you completed all of Shuvelle's quests! Hold down to add to your token bag, found in Storage Info. DONT SELL THIS ITEM
